title: PowerBots Builders
description:
Base BuildingDesign, create, and decorate your very own space station. (Base... The final frontier!)

 On-Planet MissionsCollect powerups and materials for your space station through challenging levels and boss fights.

Split-Screen MultiplayerUp to four players can join the fun in co-op or vs. mode.
 

Interactive NPCsNPCs teach you how to build, train you in combat, and offer decorations for your personalized base.

Game Features• Build your space station - Power it up. Fight to protect it.

• Interactive Events - Hazardous asteroid fields, dangerous enemies, and trading merchants visit your base.

• Items & PowerUps - Collect items to power up your bot's attacks, building abilities, and more.

• Collectables - Collect PowerStones, decorations, secret codes, and more!

• Simple, One-Button Building - Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

• Split-Screen Multiplayer - Up to four players across several game modes.
description_short: Build your base and play through on-planet worlds where every mission fuels your progress! It's time to blast off, strategically build, and boldly brawl to establish your cosmic empire and impenetrable space station.
